description: Fetch the installable eSIM(s) for a paid order: the QR code image, the LPA activation string, the SM-DP+ address and activation code for manual entry, one-tap install links for iPhone and Android, and a hosted install page to send the buyer. Identified by the order id together with the email that bought it. Returns an empty esims list while provisioning is still in flight, which normally clears within a minute of payment.

email.description: The email address the order was bought with. Required: the order id alone does not identify a buyer.

order_id.description: The order id from the buyer's confirmation email or order page.

name: get-esim-activation

esims.description: Every eSIM on this order. EMPTY while provisioning is still in flight.

activation_code.description: The activation code, for entering the profile by hand. Null before provisioning finishes.

android_link.description: One-tap install on Android, on the same terms.

apple_link.description: One-tap install on iOS. Open it ON the device that will use the eSIM. Null whenever lpa is.

install_url.description: A hosted install page, signed and safe to send a person. The same page the app and the activation email link to.

lpa.description: The GSMA activation string, "LPA:1$smdp$code". Null when the details cannot form a valid payload, which is the case you handle by falling back to the two fields above.

qr_code_url.description: The install QR as a self-contained data: URI, so it can be rendered without a second fetch. Null whenever lpa is.

smdp_address.description: The SM-DP+ server address, the other half of a manual install. Null before provisioning finishes.

status.description: eSIM state, e.g. "active". Null before the supplier has reported one.

note.description: How to get the profile onto the traveller's phone.

title: Get eSIM activation details
